changelog:
- Initial release of AlphaGBM Bull Put Spread (BPS) backtest.
- Provides walk-forward BPS backtest with and without FearScore signal, covering 2018–present for any US/HK/CN ticker.
- Returns side-by-side equity curves, key performance metrics, trade ledger, P&L distribution, and plain-language summary.
- Customizable parameters: DTE, delta, width, take profit, fear threshold, and more.
- Designed to help evaluate whether the FearScore entry rule adds real alpha.
- Includes detailed documentation and example mock data.
